source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-36

procedures.title: Hard top care and storage
steps: Clean the inside headlining as described under Cleaning Soft Trim.
Store the hard top indoors, clean and dry, when it is off the car.
For long storage, cover it so dirt does not settle on the headlining or outer surface.
